edits.description: Corrections of the pages' systems and items (each whole, as it should be, with its id) and additions (id ""). Not the ones that are right.

items.description: Everything else, one item per thing, each where it is printed, in any order. A field its kind doesn't use is null (the text "").

confidence.description: "high": clearly legible or clearly right; "medium": a reasonable guess; "low": very unsure (stained, faded, cut off).

at.description: Where in the system: its start, one of its bar lines, a stretch, or its end.

number.description: The bar line's or the stretch's number, read from the labels; 0 for start and end.

system.description: The system's number, from its label.

end.description: Where an ottava or ending ends. Null where it ends after this page, and for an item at one place.

id.description: The id of the system or item it corrects, or "" for an addition.

kind.description: What the item is: one of the kinds of observations.

anyOf.description: Staff k of n in its system.

number.description: k: the staff's position in its system, from the top.

of.description: n: the number of staves you give for that system.

staff.description: For a clef or an ottava, and a change on one staff only: its staff. Else null.

at.description: Where in the system: its start, one of its bar lines, a stretch, or its end.

number.description: The bar line's or the stretch's number, read from the labels; 0 for start and end.

system.description: The system's number, from its label.

start.description: Its place, or where it starts. Null for a note, and for an ottava or ending that starts before this page.

text.description: What it is, as its kind says ("bass clef", "3/4", the sign or numbers as printed, the note); "" where the kind uses none.

confidence.description: "high": clearly legible or clearly right; "medium": a reasonable guess; "low": very unsure (stained, faded, cut off).

id.description: The id of the system or item it corrects, or "" for an addition.

instruments.description: The probable instrument of each staff, top to bottom ("piano right hand", "violin", "voice").

system.description: The system's number, from its label.

metadata.description: What is printed about the work and the edition, one item per thing, in any order. Only what is printed.

category.description: What the item is: one of the categories of the metadata.

confidence.description: "high": clearly legible or clearly right; "medium": a reasonable guess; "low": very unsure (stained, faded, cut off).

page.description: The page it was read on.

system.description: For a piece: the system where it starts. Null for every other category.

text.description: As printed, in the page's language and spelling. For a person, the name, with the printed role in parentheses where it says more.

removals.description: The ids of the pages' systems and items that are wrong or duplicated.

score.description: Observations about the whole score, one item per thing.

confidence.description: "high": clearly legible or clearly right; "medium": a reasonable guess; "low": very unsure (stained, faded, cut off).

places.description: For recurringMaterial, its places; else an empty list.

at.description: Where in the system: its start, one of its bar lines, a stretch, or its end.

number.description: The bar line's or the stretch's number, read from the labels; 0 for start and end.

system.description: The system's number, from its label.
